# Third-party evidence

`inventory.json` is the reviewed lockfile inventory; `licenses/` preserves the upstream license and notice files byte for byte. `SOURCE_ATTRIBUTION.md` maps adapted component code and icon geometry. See `../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` for readable credits and `../docs/THIRD_PARTY_MAINTENANCE.md` for update and packaging checks.

This directory includes development dependencies for repository review. Each npm package receives a generated subset based on its runtime and peer graph, plus source attribution. Font license files and their source/hash map accompany the design-system fonts.
